summary: Cost per km of distance; effective only when options.objective.travel_cost = distance.
businessRules: per_km defines: Define the cost incurred by the vehicle for travelling a distance of one kilometer (km). When per_km cost is used, the final vehicle cost is determined based on the given value, instead of distance…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.costs.per_hour, options.objective. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Cost/distance/duration matrices must have consistent dimensions and indices.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: Behavioral: per_km cost ignored unless travel_cost=distance.
